How often should HVAC systems be serviced?
Most systems in newmarket should receive regular maintenance at least once a year to keep heating and cooling performance stable, improve energy efficiency, and reduce unexpected breakdowns.
What are signs my furnace may need repair?
Common issues include uneven heating, strange noises, or reduced airflow. In many cases, timely furnace repair from a qualified technician can restore safe and efficient operation.
Why is my air conditioner not cooling properly?
Poor airflow, low refrigerant, or clogged components can affect performance. A professional air conditioner inspection can determine whether air conditioning repair or adjustment is needed.
